title: docs(skills): the record-page skills teach relatedLists as the tab list, a group's own fields and the pinned details column (#35902, #35942)

Area: b1-RS. Claims: #35902 7072867188 (slice 2; it redoes slice 1, whose branch never reached GitHub), #35942 7072873584 (folded), #36188 7072882981 (this PR is its skills half; the seven platform-checklist JSON items are PR B, `Fixes #36188`, after this merges, because a checklist JSON beside skills paths takes a PR off the low-risk skills arm).

## 维护者速读

- AI 按技能搭建记录页时，现在知道页签由父对象的 `relatedLists` 决定：没写就照旧全部显示；写了就只显示列出的，按列的顺序；附件、审批、动态用对象名 `sys_attachment`、`sys_approval_request`、`sys_activity` 列进来；一项可写 `{ list, label, columns }` 给这张子表自己的标题和列。
- 以前技能教「把任务排第一」写 `relatedLists: ['task']`，按现在的规则这会把其他页签全藏掉。技能和评测改成「列出要保留的全部页签，任务排第一」。
- 主从子表默认是页签（#35921 之后），技能不再说「默认是正文表」；父对象分组指向子表才进字段区，而且只在使用者明确要求时才写。
- 第 1 片（分组用 `fields` 列成员、不再有阶段条和关键字段条、阶段在名字旁的状态标签里）当时没推上来，这次一起补上，关掉 #35942。
- 右栏、⊟ 开关的文字删掉，改成今天的布局：宽的整页把字段钉在左栏，其余页签在右边。
- 新增三条评测：「去掉附件页签」「税号排在行业后面」「报价单的明细放在金额上面」；指南文档记录页一节加了父单的完整报价单例子。
- 代价：只改技能文字、评测、指南和一个 changeset，不动运行时；四个技能文件都没超上限，上限一个没动（同文件删过期文字来付）。

## What changes

**`skills/objectstack-ui/rules/record-page.md`** (3954 → 3951 B, 988 / 991 tokens)
- Step 1: the stage is the status tag beside the title, whose menu moves it; no stage bar or key-field strip (`highlightFields` feed hover cards, pickers, related-list columns) (#35938, #35942). `fieldGroups` are the Details sections, each listing its members in `fields`; absent, the fields whose `group` names it (#35925). Layout: a full page fitting 320 px of details beside 400 px of tabs pins the details left, the other tabs right; unless the details hold a child table or there is no other tab; otherwise one column, Details first (#36136, `recordPagePinsDetails`). The old 760 / 1120 px two- and three-column text, the right column and the Overview tab are gone.
- Step 2 is now "The parent's `relatedLists` is the tab list" (#35923): without it nothing changes; declared, only the named lists show, in order (unlisted approvals and the stream still follow); the built-ins by object name; "tasks first" lists every tab to keep; leaving out `'sys_attachment'` drops attachments; `{ list, label, columns }`; a built-in is a bare name; a child list another package adds is hidden by a `relatedLists` that does not name it. Kept from the old step 2: `relatedList: false`, `relatedListFilter`, the default list view `sort`. A parent group `{ key, label, relatedList: 'quote_line' }` (no `fields`) places a child table among the fields, written only when asked (#35902's open question); its tab stays unless a declared `relatedLists` omits it (#35889's note, seat reading 7048340194, as shipped by #35923). The old "`'primary'` default for a master_detail" and "`relatedLists: ['task']`, no page file" are removed (#35921, #35923).
- Step 6: the ⊟ right-column switch is removed (#36188); the details column's dragged width joins the reader's choices.
- Paid for in the same file: step 1's retired layout text, step 3's "the synthesizer fills the rest", step 5's removal release ("removed in @objectstack/spec 18.3.0 (ADR-0087 D2)": the refusal carries its fix), step 6's "(drawer or full page, for a drawer-mode object)" and the deprecated `width` / `drawerWidth` aside, step 1's "the other tabs right", step 4's "a filtered split (Open vs Closed)" and step 5's "(`new_window`, `none` are the other members)" and "Field count never decides".
- The `os:check` example is a quote (`sharingModel: 'private'`) with a group listing its `fields` and a `relatedLists` entry carrying its own label and columns.

**`skills/objectstack-data/rules/relationships.md`** (16790 → 16812 B, 4203 / 4203), Detail-page related lists: every child is a tab by default, a `master_detail` child too; `false` hides; `'primary'` makes a body table with no tab; a parent group naming a `master_detail` child places its table there too (written only when asked), and its tab stays unless a declared `relatedLists` omits it; the parent's `relatedLists` is the tab list (pointing at objectstack-ui Record Page), with the built-ins and the entry form; an entry's `label` / `columns` win over `relatedListTitle` / `relatedListColumns`. Paid for by the old tri-state bullets, the "Suppress a noisy association" comment, and a shorter refusal aside ("bar a platform or sibling-artifact name", "one into a package is stored, placing nothing").

**`skills/objectstack-data/references/examples-objects.md`** (6894 → 6876 B), Field Groups: a group lists its members in `fields`; `Field.group` is the older spelling, still read; the two refusals named; the example lists members on the groups.

**`skills/objectstack-ui/rules/navigation.md`** (10251 → 10219 B): "`fieldGroups` + `Field.group`" is "`fieldGroups`", twice.

**Evals** (`skills/objectstack-ui/evals/record-page.json`, README; measured, not ratcheted):
- Case 1 (tasks first) now expects the full tab list, `task` first, and refuses `relatedLists: ['task']` and a group naming the task list. Its old answer ("already a full-width body table") is wrong since #35921.
- Case 4: remove the attachments tab: the full list without `'sys_attachment'`.
- Case 5: a Tax ID field after Industry in the group's own `fields`, with no `group` on the field.
- Case 6: a quote's line items above its Amount section instead of a tab: a group `{ key: 'lines', label, relatedList: 'quote_line' }` between the two, and a `relatedLists` naming the tabs kept without `quote_line` (an undeclared parent keeps a group-placed table's tab).
- `must_not_contain` tokens are code shapes (`relatedLists: ['task'],`, `'sys_attachment',`, `group: 'basic' }` …), so an answer that names the wrong shape in prose is not failed.
- No case's `must_not_contain` token appears in its own reference answer; every `must_contain` token does (checked by script).

**Guide (`content/docs/ui/pages.mdx`, Record pages)**: the synthesized default says every related list is a tab by default, the header's status tag carries the stage with no stage bar or strip, and an unplaced `'primary'` table sits after the field sections drawn open (it said "after the first field section"; `bodyTablePlacement` since #35742). New subsection "Declaring the tabs and the field groups": `relatedLists` as the tab list with the built-ins and entries, a group's `fields`, a group placing a child table (its tab stays unless a declared `relatedLists` leaves it out), and epic #35896's full quote example (`os:check`, with `sharingModel: 'private'`; a comment says `quote_line` is in both places on purpose, so it is drawn in the details and keeps a tab with its own columns). The layout paragraph gets its own heading, "How the page is laid out". "A one-word change on the relationship field" now reads "a declaration on the parent (a field group naming the list)".

**Changeset** `.changeset/35902-skills-related-lists-tabs.md`: `'@objectstack/skills': patch`, both declaration lines.

## Small calls made in this thread

- No ratchet ceiling moves: a `scripts/check-skills-token-ratchet.mjs` edit is outside the low-risk skills arm. All four files fit under their current ceilings.
- The skill says "no package places its own list yet" rather than naming the follow-up card: the published catalog refuses internal ids (`check-doc-authoring`).
- The Inline Editing section of `relationships.md`, `skills/objectstack-ui/rules/list-views.md:370` and `skills/objectstack-ui/SKILL.md:48` still teach that `inlineEdit: true` alone puts the child rows on the parent's form; since #35921 a parent field group decides and `inlineEdit` only picks grid or form. Not in this PR (it is form entry, not the record page's tabs, and it spans three more files): follow-up for the seat to card.
- `content/docs/ui/field-grouping-and-order.mdx` was not touched: the brief names the record-page section.

## Verification

(readings against `main` 48c732c4, head 7b3f52e1)

- Reviews on 4885e482: L1-c REWORK 7073387487 (two must-fixes, both in 7b3f52e1); Fable rules L2 PASS 7073403529 (N1 narrowed in 7b3f52e1, N2 closed by L1-c's fix 1, N3 = L1-c's fix 2, N4 left).
- `node scripts/check-skills-token-ratchet.mjs`: 60 authored files within ceilings.
- `pnpm check:skill-links` (270 links, 139 fragments), `check:skill-identifier-liveness` (549 citations), `check:doc-authoring` (75 published skill files with no internal ids; 516 doc files clean): green.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec check:skill-examples`: 348 marked examples type-check across 3 surfaces (EXIT 0), the new record-page, examples-objects and pages.mdx blocks among them.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/lint run check:doc-security-posture`: 41 `ObjectSchema.create` examples carry an `os validate`-clean posture (the first head missed `sharingModel` on both quote examples; CI caught it, fixed in 4885e482).
- The examples through `defineStack` (cross-reference validation): the guide's quote with `quote_line`, `task` and `account` accepted; control: the same quote without `quote_line` is refused (`relatedLists[0] 'quote_line' matches no inbound relationship of 'quote'`); the rule's short quote with a `quote_line` child accepted; the data skill's account accepted.
- `node scripts/pm/check-governed-merges.mjs --branch claude/project-thread-emjngv`: skills/** ×6 (all `.md` or `evals/*.json`), plus a changeset and one `content/docs` `.mdx`, 296 changed lines; the arm's `--pr` reading follows on the PR.

## Follow-ups

- PR B: the seven checklist items (`docs/qa/platform-checklist/areas/records-forms.json` ×6, `attachments-storage.json` ×1), `Fixes #36188`, in a new session after this merges.
- #35902 stays open for the #35901 batch (extension placement), the repo example and HotCRM.
- `inlineEdit` skills text (above).

- [x] 2. Every name I added uses the casing for its kind.
- [x] 3. No formatter ran; `pnpm lint` passes. (skills and doc gates above)
- [x] 4. One issue, one branch off an up-to-date `main`, one pull request.
- [x] 5. A change that publishes carries a changeset, and both declaration lines are filled in here and in the changeset.
- [x] 6. `packages/spec` touched: n/a.
- [x] 7. No hand edits to `content/docs/references/`, `packages/*/CHANGELOG.md` or `content/docs/releases/`.
- [x] 8. Title, body and comments are in English. (the 维护者速读 block is the maintainer's Chinese summary)
